steps.content: Along the way, Eleven keeps looking at her device. You glimpse her lips moving, silently reciting that poem.

You know that such Mania-related incidents always have something to do with the obsession of the person at its core. The girl in front of you and the mysterious Call at 3 AM host must have a significant connection.
But she can't speak now, and it's hard to recount the details in text.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sigh...
It seems that you still need to think of a way to ease this plight and resolve this Mania crisis.
Your sigh seems to startle Eleven. She looks at you timidly, and starts typing on her device.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "I'm sorry, did I... cause you trouble again..."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "If I've done something wrong, please don't hesitate to tell me!"
Eleven comes up to you with her device, her eyes flitting around, still not daring to look at you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hey, you've done nothing wrong. I just feel a bit frustrated having to work overtime.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I'm quite envious of you.
Hearing that, Eleven looks at you with a puzzled expression.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even your fear doesn't change your passion and anticipation for your job...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: When you have to work overtime every day while risking your life and dealing with superiors with big titles that are basically strangers to you, it's only natural you get burned out regardless of how much you loved it in the beginning...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Is... is it really that terrible?!"

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "I remember they used to say that... rookies can't leave the office before the seniors, can't start eating before the seniors, and must open the taxi door for the seniors... Could these all be true?!"
Eleven is suddenly typing really fast, leaving you stumped by the questions.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pfff...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well... that's a bit exaggerated.
You take a deep breath and start walking slowly toward the TV station with Eleven.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've got some excellent, warm, and reliable companions. Even when I'm out of strength, with them around, I become full of courage and fearless.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And I speak up and say no when something truly unreasonable happens. Be sure to remember this.
When the topic suddenly turns to herself, Eleven nods with a shy smile, and starts typing on her device while biting her lip.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Thank you, I will."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "I know what it feels like to receive encouragement in the workplace~"
As Eleven walks and types, she starts to tell her story.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "I don't know what the real Call at 3 AM podcast heard in my voice... but becoming a radio host was indeed my aspiration."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "At that time, I had just graduated and was very confused about my future... I originally planned to listen to my family and become a clerk. You know, don't stand out too much but don't be too useless..."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "But the voice in my heart was telling me... that wasn't what I wanted."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "So, I made a call to the radio program I'd always listened to..."
Eleven gazes at the TV station in the distance, the gentleness in her eyes stirring like the night breeze.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Actually... I don't really remember what exactly the radio host said... All I remember is that she said she became a host so that she could hear the voices she wanted to hear."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Her words inspired me at the time, so I followed my inner voice and became a radio host too~"
Eleven taps away on her device and shows you the text with the same shy smile on her face.
You somehow sense her anticipation, and indeed, based on what she told you, she's worth the compliment.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well, it's impressive that you've followed your own voice. That show... must be quite excellent.
Eleven shyly waves her hand and answers you with the only voice she can muster.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: No... I'm not that great of a host... This... is just... just my dream...

steps.speaker: Male Voice
steps.content: You're really not quite there yet. Although you're well dressed today, your makeup isn't perfect. As a consumer, I prefer a more innocent look...

steps.speaker: Female Voice
steps.content: A good radio host wouldn't make these mistakes. Your voice isn't sweet enough, and you stutter. You can't satisfy the listeners like this...

steps.speaker: Male Voice
steps.content: You can't finish your sentences and your voice isn't up to par. Your interactions with the audience are a tad disappointing...

steps.speaker: Female Voice
steps.content: Go to the TV station and learn from the excellent hosts there. That's how you'll realize your dream! The audience and listeners didn't spend real money just to get this. You can't daydream your way to success.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What? Who are you to judge her...

steps.speaker: Male Voice
steps.content: Who are we? We are the most perfect workers, the most perfect products...

steps.speaker: Female Voice
steps.content: Only ones like us are perfect...
Those passing men and women continue to slouch away. Their tone is calm, but those words make you frown.
The smile on Eleven's face has faded. You feel a pang of sympathy and carefully begin, wanting to offer some comfort.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't listen to them. Your dream will come true.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Believe in yourself, just like how you've followed your inner voice. We will definitely restore everything to normal and find your lost voice.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're going to realize your dream.
This world has been gleaming with an eerie glow, but now you see the light gradually returning to Eleven's eyes.
Noticing your gaze, for the first time, Eleven does not lower her head.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well, they suggested we go to the TV station to learn something. So, let's go.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Emm!
